# openobserve_composite_alert_references (Data Source)

Lists the composite alerts that reference a given alert as a child.

The server refuses to delete an alert while a composite still names it, so this answers "why can I not destroy this alert" directly, including for composites that were created outside Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The server refuses to delete an alert while a composite still names it as a
# child. This answers "what is holding on to this alert", including composites
# that were created outside Terraform.
data "openobserve_composite_alert_references" "error_rate" {
  alert_id = openobserve_alert.error_rate.alert_id
}

output "blocking_composites" {
  value = [
    for ref in data.openobserve_composite_alert_references.error_rate.references :
    ref.name
  ]
}

# Permissions can hide referencing composites from the caller. When this is not
# zero, an empty references list does not mean the alert is unreferenced, and a
# delete may still be refused.
output "references_hidden_by_permissions" {
  value = data.openobserve_composite_alert_references.error_rate.hidden_reference_count
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alert_id` (String) Alert or composite alert identifier to look up parents for.

### Optional

- `org_id` (String) Organization identifier. Defaults to the provider's `org_id`.

### Read-Only

- `hidden_reference_count` (Number) How many referencing composites permissions hid from this caller. When this is not zero, an empty `references` list does not mean the alert is unreferenced, and a delete may still be refused.
- `id` (String) Data source ID in the format `{org_id}/{alert_id}`.
- `references` (Attributes List) Composites that reference this alert and that the caller may read. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--references))

<a id="nestedatt--references"></a>
### Nested Schema for `references`

Read-Only:

- `alert_id` (String) Referencing composite's identifier.
- `folder_id` (String) Folder holding the referencing composite.
- `name` (String) Referencing composite's name.
